project.name: ilovehust
project.description: ILoveHust is a TypeScript full-stack student support web app for HUST students, covering profiles, grades, schedules, tasks, forum, messaging, realtime notifications, and admin workflows.

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Canonical Prisma data model for ILoveHust, defining users, student profiles, academic records, tasks, schedules, forum, messaging, and notifications.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive database seed script that creates demo majors, semesters, courses, users, grades, tasks, schedules, forum content, conversations, messages, and notifications.

nodes.name: realtime.ts
nodes.summary: Socket.IO realtime service that authenticates sockets with JWTs, joins per-user rooms, and exposes emit helpers for user, group, and broadcast events.

nodes.name: adminRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Backend route module for adminRoutes, exposing HTTP handlers used by the frontend.

nodes.name: authRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Express router for student registration, login, and current-user lookup with localized messages, password hashing, JWT issuance, and user response shaping.

nodes.name: aiRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: backend/routes/aiRoutes.ts supports the Express backend API and server runtime.

nodes.name: majorRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Express router exposing the authenticated majors lookup used by the student profile flow. It reads major metadata from Prisma and returns the fields needed by the frontend.

nodes.name: notificationRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Express router for listing notifications and marking one or all notifications as read. It refreshes due-task notifications, serializes notification payloads, and emits realtime unread-count changes.

nodes.name: forumRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Student forum API routes for loading posts, categories, trending topics, likes, comments, and forum summaries. The file combines Prisma queries with response shaping helpers for the forum page.

nodes.name: messageRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Student messaging API routes for conversations, search, message history, attachments, and realtime message updates. It includes response mappers and Prisma helpers for conversation membership checks.

nodes.name: scheduleRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Student schedule API routes for calendar classes, custom events, task deadlines, and period navigation. It provides date helpers and response mappers for weekly and monthly schedule views.

nodes.name: studentRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Large student API router covering dashboard data, profile completion, grades, GPA analytics, tasks, and student settings. It centralizes many Prisma-backed response builders used by student pages.

nodes.name: systemRoutes.ts
nodes.summary: Small Express router for system-level routes such as the backend health or root response. It gives the server a lightweight endpoint outside the authenticated API groups.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Backend bootstrap that creates the Express HTTP server, applies CORS and JSON middleware, mounts all route modules, initializes Socket.IO outside Vercel, and exports the app/server handles.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Configures backend TypeScript compilation for NodeNext ES modules, ES2022 output, JSON imports, Node typings, and dist output.

nodes.name: express.d.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript declaration augmentation for Express request objects, adding authenticated user metadata used by protected backend routes.

nodes.name: notifications.ts
nodes.summary: Notification utility module for creating deduplicated notifications, forum and message notification variants, due-task reminders, and frontend response serialization.

nodes.name: toUserResponse.ts
nodes.summary: User serialization helper that returns safe frontend user payloads without password hashes and with normalized profile fields.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Configures Vercel deployment for the backend API by installing dependencies, generating Prisma client code, building TypeScript, and assigning duration limits to the catch-all API function.

nodes.name: StudentHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the reusable student header with search, language switching, avatar refresh, and realtime notification controls for authenticated student pages.

nodes.name: StudentTaskbar.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the student sidebar navigation with localized menu labels, active-state handling, mobile overlay behavior, and an AI chat floating action.

nodes.name: language.ts
nodes.summary: Provides localStorage-backed language and student sidebar preference helpers shared across auth and student pages.

nodes.name: translations.ts
nodes.summary: Centralizes bilingual and localized UI copy for the frontend, including taskbar, header, dashboard, grades, authentication, profile, tasks, statistics, schedule, forum, and messaging text.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Frontend bootstrap that mounts the React app into the DOM and loads the central stylesheet.

nodes.name: AdminDashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: React page-level view for the AdminDashboard student or admin workflow.

nodes.name: Login.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the login screen, credential validation, auth API call, language selection, token persistence, and profile-completion redirect.

nodes.name: Register.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the registration screen with localized validation, account creation, token persistence, and redirect into student profile completion.

nodes.name: CompleteProfile.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the multi-step student profile completion workflow, loading current user and major data before submitting academic profile details.

nodes.name: Dashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student dashboard view that loads profile and dashboard metrics, displays GPA and task summaries, and supports quick task creation.

nodes.name: Forum.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student forum page with category filters, post creation, realtime forum updates, likes, comments, and navigation through the student layout.

nodes.name: Grades.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student grades dashboard, including grade search/filtering, summary visualization helpers, PDF export preparation, and student layout integration.

nodes.name: Messages.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student messaging page with conversation loading, realtime message updates, direct chat creation, emoji insertion, search, pagination, and attachment uploads.

nodes.name: Schedule.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student schedule calendar with date navigation, week/month views, custom event creation, localized labels, and student layout integration.

nodes.name: Settings.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student settings page for loading profile data, editing contact and academic fields, uploading avatars, and persisting language/sidebar preferences.

nodes.name: Statistics.tsx
nodes.summary: Builds the student statistics dashboard with API-backed GPA, credits, study time, achievements, goals, and cohort comparison visualizations.

nodes.name: Tasks.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the student tasks page with task loading, filtering, search, pagination, create/edit modal handling, optimistic completion, deletion, and progress statistics.

nodes.name: VietnamMap.tsx
nodes.summary: React page-level view for the VietnamMap student or admin workflow.
